verdict.rationale: Mercury's REST API/CLI cover a broad resource set (accounts, cards, transactions, invoices/AR, categories, statements, webhooks, payments) suggesting substantial UI-API parity, and OAuth2/scoped tokens support programmatic access akin to UI actions. However the flagship AI-native access point (Mercury MCP) is explicitly read-only (31 tools, all get*/list*, no create/send actions), and several UI features (AI bill-reading/auto-pay, cashback auto-deposit, universal search, spend controls UI) have no confirmed API/CLI equivalents in the evidence, so full UI parity is unconfirmed and partly contradicted by the read-only MCP design.
